rule.comment: The ILM Vault urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:ilm:static:1.0:User:LoginAllowedTimeMap is an octet string holding one bit for each half-hour period in a week. Users can logon when the bit representing the current half-hour is a 1. The Active Directory logonHours works similarly except that there is one bit for each 1 hour period in a week. This rule converts to the urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:ilm:static:1.0:User:LoginAllowedTimeMap format.
